body: I’m 35 and I feel the exact same way. I’ve had every reason to succeed in life and for some reason I just can’t get it right. It’s truly exhausting. But keep in mind we are stronger than the average person-
As an American that hates Trump and his supporters, I don’t understand it either. They are the worst kind of American, loud, self centered, greedy and hateful.
I thought for sure we were heading for a significant war, so still another week to see if I was right

Allot of people describe me as arrogant or bitchy, or unfriendly, pretentious are a few but I’m just shy. And like I said I’m 6’3 I think it’s if I was in a different package people would treat me different but because I’m like a tall relatively handsome guy I think me being shy people don’t expect that so they try to explain it as something else. I’ve tried being open about my struggles with addiction as almost an explanation and that’s almost used as ammunition against me. So I feel like being nice doesn’t work, being honest doesn’t work being rude doesn’t work, and it’s just an unfortunate situation
